excerpt_i18n.en: Leiphone.com learned that on June 24, general embodied intelligence company RoboScience successfully held a general embodied large model launch event in Shenzhen. At the event, the company fully disclosed for the first time the technical architecture of its self-developed Visics large model, VLOA (Vision-Language-Object-Action), and demonstrated the model's application in multiple real-world scenarios, including the world's most complex embodied operation task: furniture assembly. RoboScience founder and CEO Tian Ye, co-founder and executive president Wang Tao provided an in-depth interpretation of the Visics large model, its underlying technical architecture VLOA, and the data system, and shared future strategic plans for model generalization, scenario deployment, and ecosystem building. The Visics large model redefines embodied intelligence. RoboScience founder and CEO Tian Ye told Leiphone.com that current robot operations face three core bottlenecks: poor generalization ability, difficulty in fine-grained manipulation, and cumulative errors in long-horizon tasks. The breakthrough of the Visics large model lies in its first-time use of the self-developed technical architecture VLOA, which uses Object Trajectory (3D point cloud trajectory of objects) as an intermediate interface to completely decouple "cognition" from "execution." He said: "The word 'Object' has two meanings: 'thing' and 'goal.' So it precisely describes what interaction the robot should have with the object and what changes in the object's motion state should be achieved."
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Lei Feng Wang, el 24 de junio, la empresa de inteligencia física general RoboScience celebró con éxito en Shenzhen la conferencia de lanzamiento de su gran modelo general de inteligencia física. En el evento, la compañía reveló por primera vez de manera completa la arquitectura técnica VLOA (Vision-Language-Object-Action) de su gran modelo Visics desarrollado internamente, y demostró las aplicaciones del modelo en múltiples escenarios reales, incluyendo la tarea de manipulación física más compleja del mundo: el ensamblaje de muebles. excerpt_i18n.en: The Doubao you know has changed. On June 24, Doubao launched Doubao Professional Edition, based on the latest Doubao 2.1 series large model. In the past, common ways to use AI included asking questions, writing copy, editing drafts, summarizing, and generating images. The AI would provide an answer, but tasks like copying, organizing, formatting, filling forms, creating PPTs, and building web pages were still done manually. Doubao Professional Edition aims to go a step further, bringing AI out of the dialog box and into real, complex work tasks. The Professional Edition introduces an Agent-driven office task mode. It is not simply an expansion of the free version's limits or just a stronger model, but a genuine effort to assist professionals. This mode, powered by Doubao 2.1 Pro, can handle tasks such as searching for information, writing documents, and creating reports. Of course, free users' daily usage remains unaffected, and they can also experience the office task mode with Doubao 2.1 Turbo within certain limits. Currently, Doubao's paid subscription tiers are also significantly lower than those of mainstream overseas models, with reasonable pricing. In other words, Doubao has not narrowed the original free experience but has added a professional layer focused on productivity and high-frequency, intensive use. What makes the Professional Edition "professional"? Over the past year, competition among large model products has largely centered on "who answers better." Whether the model can write more natural copy, summarize web pages more accurately, better understand images, or write code—these are the most intuitive aspects for users.

Antes, la forma habitual de usar la IA era: hacer preguntas, redactar textos, corregir borradores, resumir y generar imágenes. La IA daba una respuesta, pero luego copiar, organizar, maquetar, rellenar formularios, hacer presentaciones o montar páginas web seguía siendo cosa tuya. La versión profesional de Doubao quiere ir un paso más allá: que la IA salga del cuadro de diálogo y entre en tareas de trabajo reales y complejas. Esta versión incorpora un modo de tareas ofimáticas impulsado por Agent, que no se limita a ampliar los límites de la versión gratuita ni a sustituir el modelo por uno más potente, sino que busca ayudar de verdad a los profesionales.

items.title: Retrofit, don’t rebuild: Agentic overlays for transforming legacy enterprise services
items.raw_excerpt: In this technical collaboration between AWS and the authors, we present a pragmatic solution: agentic overlays. Agentic overlays are thin wrapper layers that transform traditional REST-based services into agents capable of participating in A2A interactions. They also expose REST APIs as tools compatible with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Together, they let enterprises add A2A capabilities to existing REST services without rewriting business logic, without duplicating code, and without running parallel infrastructures. This reduces agent sprawl in the infrastructure by reusing existing services as agents. We provide reference architectures and sample code that show how to build agentic overlays.
